## MarketUtils.getLiquidationIncentiveFactor() function

Returns the liquidation incentive factor for an LLTV and liquidation cursor.

**Signature:**

```typescript
function getLiquidationIncentiveFactor(input: BigIntish | Pick<CollateralParamsInput, "lltv">, cursor: BigIntish): bigint;
```

